`1-full-pipeline.qmd` already tuned this same model on this same data. It picked a number of components with `select_best()`. This page runs the same tuning in more depth: the CV curve behind that choice, and `select_by_one_std_err()` as a simpler alternative to picking the single best value.


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(skimr)
library(plsmod)
source(here("R", "prepare_data.R"))
source(here("R", "steps.R"))
source(here("R", "split.R"))
theme_set(theme_bw())
tidymodels_prefer()
```
:::



::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
SPECTRA_DIR = here("data/RT_spectra")
SOIL_PROP_FILE = here("data/RT_wetchem_soildata.csv")
```
:::



::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
TARGET <- "carbon_tot_perc"

# --- Preprocessing ----------------------------------------------------------
RESAMPLE_BY <- 5L
RESAMPLING_GRID <- seq(3995, 600, by = -5)
SG_W        <- 15L   
SG_P        <- 3L    
SG_M        <- 1L  
```
:::



## Getting data


::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
data <- prepare_rt(SPECTRA_DIR, SOIL_PROP_FILE)|> filter(smp_id != "RT_44")
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
split <- kennard_stone_split(data, prop = 50/70, cols = starts_with("wn_"))

# or
# split <- initial_split(data, prop = 50/70)
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(123)

folds <- vfold_cv(
  training(split),
  v = 10,
  repeats = 10,
  strata = TARGET,
  breaks = 2
)
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
spc_cols <- names(data)[startsWith(names(data), "wn_")]
meta_cols <- setdiff(names(data), c(TARGET, spc_cols))

rec <- recipe(data) |>
  update_role(all_of(TARGET),  new_role = "outcome") |>
  update_role(all_of(spc_cols), new_role = "predictor") |>
  update_role(all_of(meta_cols), new_role = "metadata") |> 
  step_log(all_outcomes(), base = 10) |>
  step_resample(grid = RESAMPLING_GRID) |> 
  step_snv() |> 
  step_sg(w = SG_W, p = SG_P, m = SG_M)
```
:::



::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
pls_spec <- pls(num_comp = tune()) |>
  set_engine("mixOmics") |>
  set_mode("regression")
```
:::





::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rec) |>
  add_model(pls_spec)
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
num_comp_grid <- tibble(num_comp = 2:20)
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
tune_res <- tune_grid(
  wf,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = num_comp_grid
)
```
:::




::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
collect_metrics(tune_res)
```

::: {.cell layout-align="center"}

```{.r .cell-code}
collect_metrics(tune_res) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = num_comp, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - std_err, ymax = mean + std_err), width = 0.1, color = "grey20", linetype = "22") +
  geom_point(size=1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ .metric, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Number of PLS components", y = NULL,
       title = "CV performance vs number of PLS components")
```

best_rmse <- select_best(tune_res, metric = "rmse")
best_rmse
